
## Install

The app is not signed yet, so the system warns the first time.

- **Windows:** run `Taktwin-…-windows-x64-setup.exe`. It installs for your user only, without administrator rights. When SmartScreen says "Windows protected your PC", choose **More info → Run anyway**. `Taktwin-…-windows-x64.exe` runs without installing.
- **macOS** (Apple silicon and Intel): open `Taktwin-…-macos-universal.dmg` and drag Taktwin into Applications. On first start macOS refuses to open it: open **System Settings → Privacy & Security** and click **Open Anyway** beside Taktwin, or run `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Taktwin.app`.

`SHA256SUMS` lists the checksums of the files.
